integrity: Mathematical proof is an analytic spherical-cap enumeration with a local lens asymptotic; standalone reproducibility code is supplied. Finite numerical checks are corroborative, not proofs of the infinite-dimensional family.
scientific_limitations: The exact distribution is determined only for thresholds at least sqrt(2/3). The first-overlap asymptotic is for fixed dimension, and historical priority cannot be established exhaustively. The 1992 comparison article was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Sharp first-overlap law for random widths of regular simplices
